cards.title: Campaign Update 0.6.1
highlights: Lurkers now usable by the AI

en.title: SC: Evo 1.20.1
en.excerpt: 1.20.1: follow-up balance adjustments including reduced Concussive/Explosive damage against Shields, a Hydralisk attack speed compensation, and Protoss late-game nerfs to Dark Templar, Mind Control, and Recall.

en.title: May Development Update
en.excerpt: Just a small side-update, work has been a little slow for me due to some hardware issues, i am in the process of replacing a couple PC parts which rendered me unable to work on many parts of the project. I will sort it out soon, but i am able to work on model animation again.
